svg.text: WF-009 OP-007 Transmit underrun with automatic restart (error)

Cell = one bit clock, auto restart on, 8-bit slots. The FIFO holds one frame (two words); when it is empty at the start of the next frame, zeros are sent, the cause tx_und is set, the unit leaves the frame and waits in ARM; two words written later restart it at a frame boundary.
